parameters.query:
WITH o AS (SELECT id, telegram_id FROM users WHERE role='owner' AND is_active=true LIMIT 1),
stale AS (UPDATE schedule_entries se SET status='skipped' FROM o WHERE se.user_id=o.id AND se.status='planned' AND se.end_at < now() - interval '30 minutes' RETURNING se.id),
started AS (UPDATE schedule_entries se SET status='in_progress' FROM o WHERE se.user_id=o.id AND se.status='planned' AND se.start_at<=now() AND se.end_at>now() RETURNING se.id),
ended AS (UPDATE schedule_entries se SET status='completed', actual_minutes=COALESCE(se.actual_minutes, se.planned_minutes) FROM o WHERE se.user_id=o.id AND se.status='in_progress' AND se.end_at<=now() RETURNING se.id),
pre AS (INSERT INTO notifications (user_id,type,importance,title,payload,dedupe_key,status,sent_at)
  SELECT o.id,'session_pre','normal',se.title,jsonb_build_object('entry_id',se.id),'sess_pre:'||se.id::text,'sent',now()
  FROM schedule_entries se, o WHERE se.user_id=o.id AND se.status='planned' AND se.start_at>now() AND se.start_at<=now()+interval '10 minutes'
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING (payload->>'entry_id')::uuid AS entry_id),
r AS (SELECT 'end'::text AS kind, id FROM ended UNION ALL SELECT 'start', id FROM started UNION ALL SELECT 'pre', entry_id FROM pre)
SELECT r.kind, o.telegram_id::text AS telegram_id, se.title, se.session_type, se.is_fixed, se.objective, se.planned_minutes,
  to_char(se.start_at AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Cairo','HH24:MI') AS start_t, to_char(se.end_at AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Cairo','HH24:MI') AS end_t,
  GREATEST(0, ceil(extract(epoch FROM (se.start_at-now()))/60))::int AS mins_to_start,
  (SELECT string_agg(t.title,'، ') FROM schedule_entry_tasks st JOIN tasks t ON t.id=st.task_id WHERE st.schedule_entry_id=se.id) AS tasks,
  nx.next_title, nx.next_start, nx.next_end, nx.next_type, nx.next_objective
FROM r JOIN schedule_entries se ON se.id=r.id CROSS JOIN o
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT n.title AS next_title, to_char(n.start_at AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Cairo','HH24:MI') AS next_start, to_char(n.end_at AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Cairo','HH24:MI') AS next_end, n.session_type AS next_type, n.objective AS next_objective
  FROM schedule_entries n WHERE r.kind='end' AND n.user_id=o.id AND n.id<>se.id AND n.status='planned' AND n.start_at>=se.end_at-interval '2 minutes' AND n.start_at<=now()+interval '18 hours' AND n.session_type NOT IN ('sleep','rest','break') ORDER BY n.start_at LIMIT 1) nx ON true
ORDER BY CASE r.kind WHEN 'end' THEN 0 WHEN 'start' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, se.start_at
SELECT generate_schedule(u.id, 7) AS created FROM users u WHERE u.role='owner' AND u.is_active=true LIMIT 1
